name: Dart Monkey

farm.helpers: hero Gwendolin ($615 Easy, no XP share)

bestCrosspaths.use: Sharp Shooter: cheap MOAB crits (v57 crit 60)
Crossbow Master: mid-game, falls off after R80

buyTiming: Base/0-0-2 on R1-R24 for camo; Juggernaut by R28-R38 for lead; Sharp Shooter R40s; Ultra-Jugg R50-R60; PMFC late CHIMPS only.
synergies: Alchemist Berserker Brew (Jugg/UJ; Brew hurts Sharp Shooter)
lacks: Strong MOAB DPS until Sharp Shooter/Crossbow Master
summary: Best first Paragon target: ~$245k Apex, 622,300 XP total, mono-Deflation capable once Juggernaut is unlocked.

synergies: Alchemist Berserker Brew (Jugg/UJ; Brew hurts Sharp Shooter per ch01)

lead: A cheap, reliable early-game popper. Upgrades add camo, then Juggernaut for Lead and Ceramics, and it's the cheapest tower to take to a Paragon.

name: Boomerang Monkey

farm.helpers: 1x Monkey Sub 3-0-0 ($1,405 Easy); hero Etienne ($555 Easy, no XP share)

unlockOrder: 0-0-2 Red Hot Rangs (600 XP total) for lead
buyTiming: 1-0-2/0-0-2 by R28 (lead); Ricochet R30s; Turbo/Perma Charge R50+ as single-target.
summary: Needs a camo helper for Deflation (~8% XP share); Glaive Dominus is the 3rd-cheapest Paragon by XP (634k).
lead: An early-game popper whose rangs bounce through crowds and Ceramics, and pop Lead from x-x-2. It never sees camo, so bring a helper.

name: Bomb Shooter

farm.setup: 2x Bomb Shooter 0-4-2; 1x Bomb Shooter 0-2-4; 1x Bomb Shooter 0-2-3
farm.helpers: 1x Monkey Sub 3-0-0 ($1,405 Easy); hero Striker Jones ($595 Easy, no XP share)

bestCrosspaths.use: MOAB Mauler: first MOAB answer R40-50
MOAB Eliminator: cheapest strong anti-blimp T5

buyTiming: Mauler by R39; Assassin by R50-R60; Eliminator R70s-R90s.
summary: Cheap MOAB answer; farm with a 3-0-0 Sub helper (~7% share). 888k XP to B.O.M.B.
lead: Splash damage for crowds and Lead, and later a strong MOAB killer. Explosions can't pop Black or Zebra, and it has no camo upgrade.

name: Tack Shooter

farm.helpers: 1x Monkey Sub 3-0-0 ($1,405 Easy); hero Gwendolin ($615 Easy, no XP share)

buyTiming: 2-0-x/x-0-2 R1-R20 on tight curves; Hot Shots by R28; Overdrive/RoF R40-60; Tack Zone R60+.
synergies: Primary Training/Mentoring Village (huge on low-range primaries)
summary: Second-cheapest Paragon (Crucible $200k, 623k XP). Needs one cheap decamo helper in Deflation.
lead: A short-range crowd popper for tight corners: put it right next to the track. It needs help with camo.

name: Ice Monkey

farm.helpers: hero Silas ($725 Easy, no XP share)

buyTiming: Embrittlement R50-R70 as support; Super Brittle R80+ / bosses.
summary: Lowest all-upgrade XP of any Paragon tower (118k) but the Herald unlock is 750k. Farm with Silas; share in normal games is low.
lead: A support tower that freezes and slows Bloons to buy time. Embrittlement makes Bloons take extra damage from every tower.

name: Glue Gunner

farm.setup: 1x Glue Gunner 4-2-0; 1x Glue Gunner 2-0-3; 1x Glue Gunner 3-2-0
farm.helpers: 1x Mortar Monkey 0-0-3 ($1,955 Easy); hero Sauda ($510 Easy, no XP share)

_src.caveat: Round 3: the Mortar 0-0-3 Signal Flare decamo has the same flaw as the rejected Sniper plan: one fixed reticle covers only one of Infernal's two alternating lanes (odd top, even bottom). Glue cannot target camo, so camo rounds on the other lane leak. Use a Village 0-2-0 Radar ($2,930 Easy) within reach of the Glues instead, or run it on a single-lane Expert map. Untested (calc).

notes_internal.caveat: Round 3: the Mortar 0-0-3 Signal Flare decamo has the same flaw as the rejected Sniper plan: one fixed reticle covers only one of Infernal's two alternating lanes (odd top, even bottom). Glue cannot target camo, so camo rounds on the other lane leak. Use a Village 0-2-0 Radar ($2,930 Easy) within reach of the Glues instead, or run it on a single-lane Expert map. Untested {calc}.

bestCrosspaths.use: MOAB Glue with splatter: blimp slow

buyTiming: 2-x-x/x-2-x early only if you're slowing a carry; MOAB Glue R50+; Super Glue R80+.
synergies: Any carry (glue makes them hit more)
summary: No Paragon; low priority XP. Most realistic farm is Deflation with a decamo Mortar and Sauda.
lead: A cheap slowing tower that holds Bloons in place for your damage dealers. It does no damage at base and can't target camo.

name: Desperado

farm.helpers: hero Gwendolin ($615 Easy, no XP share)

bestCrosspaths.use: The Blazing Sun: cheap boss damage

buyTiming: Base/0-1-0 from R1 (CHIMPS starts); Big Iron R28; Twin Sixes R40-50; Blazing Sun R60+.
lacks: Crowd damage outside the shotgun path
summary: Mono-farmable from tier 3. Note: Desperado is Primary, so no Elite Military bonus.

_src.summary: Mono-farmable from tier 3. Note: Desperado is Primary (bloonswiki), so no Elite Military bonus.

lead: An early-game gunslinger with strong single-target damage and camo upgrades. A solid CHIMPS starter.

name: Sniper Monkey

farm.setup: 2x Sniper Monkey 2-0-4 (Full Auto Rifle, $8,240 Easy each)
farm.helpers: Monkey Village 0-2-0 Grow Blocker + Radar Scanner ($2,930 Easy; Radar gives camo to the infinite-range Snipers on both alternating lanes); hero Quincy ($460 Easy, no XP share). Total $19,870 of $20,000

notes_internal.rank2: Etienne ($555 Easy) instead of Quincy; once Etienne shows level 8 (UAV camo, ~end of R48, unverified) sell the Village (~$2,050) and add a 3rd Sniper 1-0-2 ($1,355): ~55,496 XP/run no MK (62,933 MK) -> 3 runs to T5, 17 (15 MK) to Paragon
notes_internal.verified: VERIFY-3 section 3 ranking; untested in game
notes_internal.indexEvidence: Index v57.4 (btd6index.win, fetched 2026-11-05): Infernal lanes 19.3 RBS each (longest Expert; Glacial Trail next at 17.7), no LoS blockers, water yes; Elite Sniper and Elite Defender both have 2MP (solo CHIMPS) completions on Infernal.
notes_internal.rejected: Mortar 0-0-3 Signal Flare decamo plan fails on Infernal: one fixed reticle, lanes alternate (odd top / even bottom); R56 full leak 1,880 lives vs 200
notes_internal.alternative100pct: 1x 4-2-0 + 2x 2-3-0 + Sauda ($18,220 Easy, 100% share, 67,739 XP/run MK, 14 runs to Paragon) - covers camo/lead in-tower but has no attack-speed upgrades; DPS untested

bestCrosspaths.use: Cripple MOAB (preferred unless heavy speed buffs)

buyTiming: Several 0-0-0s R1-R10; 1-1-0 by R24-R28; Maim R60s; Elite Defender for R95-R100/bosses.
lacks: Line of sight on cluttered maps
summary: Military (+5% XP, +1,000 one-off). Mono-farmable; S.P.I.D.E.R. needs 895,200 XP (894,200 after the EMT +1,000).
lead: Hits any Bloon it can see, anywhere on the map, as long as nothing blocks its line of sight. Use it for camo, Lead and MOAB answers, or Supply Drop cash outside CHIMPS.

name: Monkey Sub

farm.setup: 2x Monkey Sub 0-2-4; 1x Monkey Sub 2-0-4; 1x Monkey Sub 3-2-0
farm.helpers: hero Admiral Brickell ($765 Easy, no XP share)

buyTiming: 2-0-2 R1-R30 on water maps; Submerge for camo; AP Darts R40-R60; Pre-emptive for R90+ DDTs.
synergies: Camo spotter (0-0-2 Dart or 0-1-0 Desperado) for Intel
lacks: Lead on Advanced Intel paths without x-2-x
summary: Water-locked but mono-farmable on Dark Castle. Biggest XP walls: First Strike 20k, Pre-emptive 45k, Paragon 1M.
lead: A water-only tower that is strong early and grows into a MOAB killer. Only usable on maps with water.

name: Monkey Buccaneer

farm.helpers: hero Admiral Brickell ($765 Easy, no XP share)

buyTiming: 0-0-2 for camo early; Destroyer R35-R40; Merchantmen R20-R50 in non-CHIMPS eco.
summary: Navarch is the easiest high-Degree Paragon because Merchantman income feeds power. Mono-farmable on Dark Castle.
lead: A water-only tower that makes money (Merchantman, Trade Empire) and handles MOABs. Only usable on maps with water.

name: Monkey Ace

farm.setup: 1x Monkey Ace 4-2-0; 1x Monkey Ace 3-2-0; 3x Monkey Ace 2-3-0
farm.helpers: hero Rosalia ($745 Easy, no XP share)

buyTiming: Not early ($800). Fighter Plane R40; Dart Storm R50-R60; Sky Shredder/Fortress R80+.
summary: Strongest Paragon (Doomship) and the best-known AFK Deflation farm; 1.16M XP to Paragon (1.16M minus 1,000 EMT).
lead: A late-game MOAB and boss killer. Weak early on, but its Paragon is the strongest in the game.

name: Heli Pilot

farm.helpers: hero Rosalia ($745 Easy, no XP share)

buyTiming: Mid-game buy ($1,500 base). MOAB Shove by R40-R60; Apache R60+.
summary: No Paragon; heavy T5 XP (Apache Prime 55k, Comanche Commander 50k). Mono-farmable.
lead: A mobile flying tower that ignores obstacles. Best for late-game MOAB damage and pushing blimps back.

name: Mortar Monkey

farm.setup: 1x Mortar Monkey 0-4-2; 3x Mortar Monkey 0-3-2; 1x Mortar Monkey 0-2-3
farm.helpers: hero Striker Jones ($595 Easy, no XP share)

buyTiming: 0-0-0 for R4 blues; Heavy Shells by R40; Artillery R50-R70; Pop and Awe/Blooncineration R80+.
summary: Mono-farmable and nearly AFK. Also the best land decamo helper (0-0-3 Signal Flare) for other towers' farms.
lead: Fires explosive shells at a spot you choose, so placement barely matters. Good for crowds and Lead.

name: Dartling Gunner

farm.helpers: hero Psi ($850 Easy, no XP share)

buyTiming: Mid-game ($850 base). Hydra/Rocket Storm R40-R60; M.A.D R80+.
summary: No Paragon and the highest Military T5 XP (Ray of Doom 75k, M.A.D 60k).
lead: A rapid-fire gun that shoots where you aim it. Weak early, but strong against MOABs and bosses late.

name: Wizard Monkey

farm.setup: 2x Wizard Monkey 0-2-4; 1x Wizard Monkey 0-3-2; 1x Wizard Monkey 0-2-3
farm.helpers: hero Ezili ($470 Easy, no XP share)

buyTiming: 0-2-0 for R28/R30 leads; Dragon's Breath R30s; Necromancer R40s; Archmage/PoD R60+.
lacks: Purple on bolt/fire attacks (Necromancer undead can damage any type)
summary: ~1.14M XP to Magus Perfectus (143,290 for all 15 incl. an estimated 150 for Intense Magic, + 1,000,000); third-highest Paragon total after Ace and Sub. Deflation-farmable: Necromancer undead cover Purple in-tower; Ezili is insurance.
lead: A flexible Magic tower that pops Lead, sees and strips camo with upgrades, and handles DDTs. Prince of Darkness is a CHIMPS favourite.

name: Super Monkey

farm.helpers: 1x Mortar Monkey 0-0-3 ($1,955 Easy); hero Ezili ($470 Easy, no XP share)

buyTiming: Not before ~R50 (base $2,500); Sun Avatar R55-R70; Temple/Anti-Bloon R80+ or freeplay.
synergies: Adora (Sun Avatar buff, True Sun God)
summary: Most XP-expensive tower (493,850 XP for all 15; T5s alone 335k) and no Paragon. Level it last unless you love Sun Temples.
lead: The big late-game damage dealer. Expensive early, but its tier 5s carry freeplay and boss events.

name: Ninja Monkey

farm.helpers: hero Gwendolin ($615 Easy, no XP share)

buyTiming: Base Ninja R1-R24 for camo; 3-0-1 R30s; Sabotage before DDTs (R90); Sticky R40-R60.
synergies: Alchemist AMD/Brew (lead, double damage on shurikens)
summary: Fourth-cheapest Paragon by XP (677k). Mono-farmable; Ascended Shadow is a freeplay staple.
lead: A cheap early tower that sees camo from the start. Upgrades add camo removal and slowing; shurikens can't pop Lead.

name: Alchemist

farm.helpers: 2x Ninja Monkey 4-0-1 ($8,600 Easy); hero Obyn Greenfoot ($555 Easy, no XP share)

bestCrosspaths.use: Brew for slow attackers (1.25x as often)
Rubber to Gold (income; none in CHIMPS since the 57.1 hotfix)

buyTiming: 2-0-0/3-x-x next to your carry R30-R50; Stronger Stim R60s; Permanent Brew R80+.
synergies: Any fast many-projectile tower (Ninja, Dart, Quincy, Adora, Sub)
summary: Highest value per dollar but low XP share as a helper. Use the Alchemist+Ninja split farm to level both at once.
lead: A support tower that buffs nearby towers (Berserker Brew) and pops Lead. It never sees camo and does little damage alone.

name: Druid

farm.helpers: hero Obyn Greenfoot ($555 Easy, no XP share)

buyTiming: 1-0-x early; Wrath/Poplust R30-R50; Spirit of the Forest R60+.
playstyles: eco (Jungle's Bounty: passive end-of-round cash since v53, ability now Vine Crush; none in CHIMPS)
summary: Mono-farmable with Obyn; Root of all Nature needs 903,510 XP total.
lead: An early popper that can earn passive cash with Jungle's Bounty (not in CHIMPS). It needs upgrades for Lead and camo.

name: Mermonkey

farm.helpers: hero Admiral Brickell ($765 Easy, no XP share)

_src.changed: 0.10: was 1x 0-4-2 + 3x 0-3-2. That mix had no White, Zebra or Purple popper (middle-path Mermonkeys deal cold damage; data/game/towers.json), so R31 Whites and R32 Purples leaked. Abyssal Warrior 4-0-2 pops them; the 0-3-2s keep Lead. Same XP (all Mermonkey), $12,315 Easy.

bestCrosspaths.use: Lord of the Abyss: water on dry maps (CHIMPS)

buyTiming: Base Mermonkey R1 (very cost-effective); Riptide R30s; T5s are late and XP-heavy.
synergies: Spike Factory (Lord of the Abyss buff)
summary: No Paragon but huge T5 XP (190k total in T5s). Mono-farmable from tier 3.
lead: An early-game Magic tower that can sit on land or water, with slowing and support paths. Its range is shorter on land.

name: Skywarden

farm.helpers: hero Obyn Greenfoot ($555 Easy, no XP share)

_src.changed: 0.10: was 1x 2-4-0 + 3x 2-3-0 + 2x 3-2-0. No crosspath in that mix pops Purple (data/game/towers.json), so R32 Purples leaked. A 2-0-4 pops Purple; the 2-x-0s keep Lead. Same XP (all Skywarden), $17,760 Easy.

buyTiming: Cheap ($205) from R1; T3 combos R30-R50 (balance still moving).
summary: No Paragon; ~150.7k XP for all upgrades. Mono-farmable on paper; recheck after each patch.
lead: The newest Magic tower: an early support pick that buffs nearby towers' range and gets camo with upgrades. Expect balance patches.

name: Banana Farm

farm.setup: Best real method: Impoppable (or Hard) on an Expert map with a heavy farming plan - farms typically hold a large share of invested cash from R20-R60.
farm.helpers: Full normal defence; target share ~35% (estimate)

buyTiming: 2-0-0 farms R10-R35 when safe; Bank R30s; BRFs R40-R60; Central R50-R60; stop before R40 if shaky.
summary: Level it inside normal Hard/Impoppable eco games; Deflation only as a share sponge.
lead: Makes money every round so you can afford bigger towers later. It does no damage and is banned in CHIMPS.

name: Spike Factory

farm.helpers: hero Striker Jones ($595 Easy, no XP share)

buyTiming: Base factory R20-R37 as camo backstop; 2-x-x by R28; SHREDR R40; Spike Storm before R100.
summary: One of the easiest mono-farms (Dark Castle). 1.14M XP to MMMF.
lead: Lays spikes on the track to catch whatever gets past your defence. It sees camo and makes a strong backstop near the exit.

name: Monkey Village

farm.helpers: 3x Dart Monkey 4-0-2 ($7,515 Easy); hero Gwendolin ($615 Easy, no XP share)

bestCrosspaths.use: Commerce discount, sold after building (Deflation trick)

buyTiming: 0-0-2 placed first before tier-3 buys; 2-2-0 by R30-R40; MIB before R90 DDTs.
synergies: Commerce discount stacks to 25% across 3 villages
summary: Highest utility per XP in the game; level it via split farms and normal games.
lead: Buffs every tower in its radius: attack speed, range, camo detection and discounts. It does no damage itself.

name: Engineer Monkey

farm.setup: 2x Engineer Monkey 4-0-2; 1x Engineer Monkey 0-3-2; 1x Engineer Monkey 0-2-4
farm.helpers: hero Gwendolin ($615 Easy, no XP share)

buyTiming: 0-0-3 Double Gun early on single lanes; Foam R30s; Overclock once you have a carry (R50+); Trap R30-R55.
lacks: MOAB/BFB damage inside a $20k Deflation budget (Bloon Trap ignores MOAB-class; XXXL Trap is $45k)
summary: Overclock is one of the most valuable T4s in the game. The all-Engineer Deflation farm covers every Bloon type but lacks a blimp answer inside $20k (Bloon Trap can't catch MOAB-class), so bring a blimp helper.
lead: A cheap early tower that becomes a top support pick: Overclock speeds up another tower. Sentries and Bloon Traps add damage and cash.

name: Beast Handler

farm.setup: 1x Beast Handler 0-4-0; 1x Beast Handler 0-2-3; 1x Beast Handler 0-0-3
farm.helpers: hero Pat Fusty ($680 Easy, no XP share)

unlockOrder: Tier 3s first (1,000 XP each, best value)
buyTiming: Tier 3s R20-R40; T-Rex R50-R60 (CHIMPS).
summary: Cheap tiers 1-4 (21,050 XP) but brutal T5 XP (300k). Farm tiers 3-4 early, T5s last.
lead: Raises fish, dinosaurs and birds that grab, drag and stomp Bloons, up to blimps. Short range, and Alchemist buffs don't affect it.
